material.acceptance_criteria: After a shift-queued unit dies, QUEUE holds no entry for its id on the next tick, and on_tick returns at the next(QUEUE) check when no living unit has a queue.
material.description: scenarios/moba/controls.lua:218 declares QUEUE; :248-250 append a queued order per unit; the only deletes are :252 (non-queued issue), :262 (stop), :270 (hold) and :602 (empty queue of a living unit). on_tick (:587-605) skips a unit with game.alive(id) false at :600 and never removes its entry. After one shift-queued unit dies, next(QUEUE) (:587) is never nil again, so every tick rebuilds and insertion-sorts every leaked id (:590-597). Symptom: per-tick Lua cost and table size grow with each queued unit killed in a match. Fix: drop QUEUE[id] for a dead unit in on_tick, or clear it from the death path.

notes.note: Published controls.lua 3292a7ca (on_tick drops a dead unit's QUEUE entry). Witness blocked: no Lua runtime in this sandbox for a standalone run and no live match: Live check (browser dispatch 1792862772886-5303-5a481f4722e0f263, session verify-PARSEDV-trav-controls-lua-1, page https://lanmower.github.io/oscraft/js/client/play.html at 1280x720): the lobby joins a room but stays at "loading world assets: still pending after 15 s"; console shows WebSocket wss://relay.damus.io/ handshake 503. A match cannot start, so the in-game witness is blocked by lobby-disabled-when-one-relay-503. CI 3292a7ca red on the existing workspace-tests row.

material.subject: Shift-queued orders of a dead unit are never cleared, so the queue table and on_tick cost grow
material.witness: Live Pages site: served scenarios/moba/controls.lua (HTTP 200) on_tick has the dead-unit branch 'if q ~= nil and not game.alive(id) then QUEUE[id] = nil'. Fix commit 3292a7ca is an ancestor of green tip 7f68d3bc (ci success 6/6). Runtime queue size is not exposed to the page, so the witness reads the served code, not the queue.
material.witness_plan: Live match: shift-queue a move on a unit, kill it, and confirm on_tick stops iterating (read the queue size through a debug action or a timing sample). Static: codesearch QUEUE in scenarios/moba/controls.lua shows no delete on the death path.
